== English Virtual Original comparison ==
The 2006 face adds presence at a site to the forfeit +2 and fallback destiny. The early source refers to a Blaster Rifle while the later source uses the blaster rifle weapon characteristic (lowercase); January 2002 Glossary Supplement recognizes that characteristic. The separately printed +2 weapon-or-battle destiny line, deploy/forfeit and warrior icon remain.
